environment.description: ECS Fargate task running in a public subnet with default AWS networking. Task role has broad permissions including ssm:GetParameter and secretsmanager:GetSecretValue. The container runs with the default Fargate platform version 1.4.0 which exposes the task metadata endpoint at 169.254.170.2 and the IMDS-like credential endpoint. No network policy or egress filtering is applied. The task IAM role trust policy allows ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com.
